label: main season
summary: Recommend cancellation by non-technical survey. Two different first-hand land users (E5 and E6) each report 19 years of safe use, satisfying the national minimum. There is no direct or qualifying indirect evidence of EO in the area; the survey team’s inability to see the interior on visits 1 and 2 is not evidence either way. The outcome passed the rule check.
flags: The survey team could not see the area interior during visits 1 and 2; cancellation relies on reports from people who use the land.
The nearest database accident is 1–3 km from the area, not recorded inside it; it does not trigger the inside-area clearance criterion.
The zone survey flag and priority are visit-planning information, not evidence about EO presence.

checks.detail: Every item of the evidence log is in the register.
There is no direct evidence and no indirect evidence of class 1 to 4, and every item of weaker indirect evidence is explained by evidence of absence of class 1 to 4.
2 different reliable source(s) report at least 5 years of safe use (E5; E6); the criteria need 2.
No past landmine accident is recorded inside the area.

E1.quote: The survey team could reach only the edge of the area, because rain had closed the trail into it, and could not see the land inside.
E1.note: The team could not observe the interior, so this neither supports presence nor absence.

E2.quote: The people at the community meeting had moved to the vereda in the last 2 years and could not say how the area was used before.
E2.note: These recent residents lacked knowledge of prior land use and provide no information about EO presence or absence.

E3.quote: The survey team could reach only the edge of the area, because rain had closed the trail into it, and could not see the land inside.
E3.note: The team could not observe the interior, so this neither supports presence nor absence.

E4.quote: the board has recorded no find or accident in the area in the 3 years she has held the post, and that families use land in the area every week.
E4.note: The informant reports regular use and no recorded events during her three-year tenure, but this does not meet the five-year duration criterion by itself.

E5.quote: We have kept a cassava and sugar-cane field here for 19 years. Nobody has found anything, and nobody has been hurt.
E5.note: A family using the land first-hand reports 19 years of safe use.

E6.quote: We have grown coffee and plantain here for 19 years. Nobody has found anything, and nobody has been hurt.
E6.note: A first-hand land user reports 19 years of safe use.
